# vtools3 workspace instructions

Follow the local project guidance in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md).

For Sphinx documentation work, use the [documentation skill](skills/documentation/SKILL.md).
The runtime environment plus docs overlay supplies `vtools3_doc`; `make html`
generates API pages and HTML. Contributor instructions are in
[contributing_docs.rst](../docsrc/contributing_docs.rst).
